## Why

What problem does this change solve? Link a related issue if one exists.

## Behavior

What changes for a writer or API consumer? Include any data-format or privacy effects.

## Verification

List the tests actually run, their results, and checks not run. Add UI screenshots for a visual change when available; use fictional data.

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests are included.
- [ ] No private writing, credentials, or invented results are included.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration effects are described when applicable.
